king.movement: one square all directions; own citadel entry from corner
king.notes: Normal king movement fits. Citadel entry and draw rules do not fit plain config.

picket.fairyCandidate: native timur_picket_attacks_bb in the Fairy fork source
picket.note: Plain variants.ini can still over-generate one-square diagonal moves; production support lives in the native timur variant source.

giraffe.movement: one empty diagonal step, then at least 3 straight orthogonal squares in the same diagonal direction
giraffe.fairyCandidate: native timur_giraffe_attacks_bb in the Fairy fork source
giraffe.note: Plain variants.ini keeps this piece immobile to avoid wrong POC moves; production support lives in the native timur variant source.

pawn.movement: one forward, diagonal capture, no double step
pawn.notes: Different pawn types and pawn-of-pawns cycle require wrapper or multiple pawn types.

royal_capture.reason: Timur royal hierarchy can involve Shah, Prince and Adventitious King; JS remains the final game-over arbiter until native multi-royal logic is rebuilt.

royal_swap.reason: Special Shah ransom/swap move is generated and validated by JS, then marked as a known Fairy wrapper difference.

citadel_draw.reason: Citadels are off-board coordinates, so entry/draw resolution stays in JS until native board extension is rebuilt.

citadel_exchange.reason: Citadel exchange is a compound move with state flags; JS keeps the authoritative apply/revert path.

pawn_of_pawns_cycle.reason: Pawn-of-pawns can repatriate twice and then promote to Adventitious King; this remains JS post-move state logic.

promotion_suffix.reason: Fixed Timur pawn subtype promotion suffixes are accepted only when they match the parity matrix; pawn-of-pawns cycle remains JS authoritative.

threefold_repetition.reason: Fairy native timur variant sets nFoldRule = 3 and JS has a matching safety helper.

fifty_move_draw.reason: Fairy native timur variant sets nMoveRule = 50 and JS has a matching quiet-ply helper.

stalemate_win.reason: Fairy native timur variant sets stalemateValue = VALUE_MATE; JS still validates game UI/result flow.
